items.title: Empowering India’s next generation of innovators with ATL Saathi
items.summary: Google and AIM launched ATL Saathi, a Gemini-powered AI tool empowering Indian educators in robotics labs.
items.summaryZh: 谷歌DeepMind与Atal创新使命（AIM）合作推出了ATL Saathi的现场试点，这是一个由Gemini模型驱动的Web应用，旨在为印度的“创客实验室”教师提供全天候的规划和培训助手，将科学教育与国家课程标准深度融合。

items.title: How GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna compare on intelligence vs cost
items.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna are ahead of Terra at every point on the Intelligence vs Cost per Task chart. GPT-5.6 Luna stands out as a particularly cost efficient model
